Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Join a diverse team of approx. 2000 professionals across four continents, driving innovation and growth within intive’s technology hubs. Work alongside industry experts trusted by leading brands like Audi, BMW, Deichmann, Meta, NewsCorp, Tandem, Paramount, Vorwerk, and Warner Bros. Discovery to create pioneering, sustainable digital experiences.
 At intive, agile thinking and deep industry expertise come together across Automotive & Mobility, Commerce, Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, and Technology, Media & Communication. Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of digital innovation.
 Job Description
 Scope of Duties
Ensure platform reliability through high-availability setups, backup/restore procedures, and disaster recovery planning
Deploy and maintain services in cloud and on-premises environments
Operate and maintain containerized workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm-based deployments and GitOps workflows using Argo CD
Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform and Ansible
Autonomously implement complete technical solutions and infrastructure components from scratch
Operate and maintain PostgreSQL databases on Amazon RDS, including backup, tuning, and version upgrades
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, following established patterns and including automated quality gates and testing
Implement and maintain identity and access management, including SSO integrations via Keycloak (OIDC/SAML)
Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability using Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry
Provide 3rd level support and participate in incident management, including root cause analysis and resolution
Support cloud migration projects, including cutover planning and execution
Perform patch and upgrade management of infrastructure and services
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve technical and infrastructure-related issues
Develop Python and shell scripts to automate operational and infrastructure-related tasks
Contribute to internal developer platform capabilities, including service catalogs and developer portals (Backstage)
Contribute to technical documentation, including system architecture and IT product documentation, following docs-as-code principles
 Services Experience
3+ years of professional experience in a DevOps Engineer or similar infrastructure-focused role
Strong experience with platform operations, including high availability, backup/restore, and disaster recovery
Strong hands-on experience with AWS core services and Linux on AWS, preferably Amazon Linux
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Practical experience with Ansible for infrastructure automation and configuration management
Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized environments
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including Helm and GitOps-based deployment workflows (Argo CD)
Practical experience operating PostgreSQL, preferably on Amazon RDS
Experience with GitLab CI/CD and pipeline implementation following established patterns
Solid Git experience, including branching strategies and repository migrations
Practical experience with artifact management (Artifactory, Nexus)
Experience with IAM and SSO concepts, including Keycloak and OIDC/SAML integrations
Hands-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry for monitoring and observability
Experience with incident management and 3rd level support processes
Experience with cloud migration and cutover activities
Experience with patch and upgrade management of infrastructure and services
Experience with Python and shell scripting for automation and operational tasks
Familiarity with code quality practices and automated testing
Familiarity with platform engineering concepts and developer portals (Backstage)
Basic knowledge of TypeScript and frontend development (e.g. for Backstage plugin customization)
